summary: This document introduces a hub and spoke multipoint (HSMP) Label Switched Path, which carries traffic from the root to the leaves along a point-to-multipoint LSP and also from leaves back to the root along the reverse path. It does this with extensions to LDP.

eli5.summary: Picture a bus route where the hub sends passengers out to every stop, and every stop can also send passengers back to the hub. This adds that to a network.

questions: ldp hub and spoke multipoint lsp
